events.title: Enemy Spotlight: The Cycloguard
events.summary: Hey RealmWalkers!With our Demo launch less than 2 weeks away, it’s time to meet one of the towering foes that patrol The Shifting Dunes, the earth realm prison you’ll explore first in RealmWalker - the Cycloguard. Once nomadic warriors of sand and stone, these brutes now serve under Anuragon, leader of all the Cyclotaurs, forming an elite line of defense. events.title: Spell Deep Dive: Temporal Shift
events.summary: Hey RealmWalkers! Welcome to our first Spell Deep Dive! Today we’re exploring Temporal Shift, an Arcane spell built for crowd control and tactical dominance. Casting Temporal Shift creates a pocket of distorted time around you. Enemies caught inside move in slow motion, giving you a perfect window to unleash your strongest attacks. With upgrades, its power grows:Buff Refresh: Extend the duration of your active buffs while in the domain.Guaranteed Stasis: When the effect ends, enemies are locked
